Container.Name: tetherd
Container.Overview: Keeps containers attached to the network of the container they route through, such as apps using --network container:gluetun. When the VPN container restarts, those apps stay running but go offline; Tetherd repairs that with a restart where possible, and only rebuilds when the VPN container was recreated. Clean-room successor to Rebuild-DNDC: it reads live Docker config, not Unraid XML. Stop Rebuild-DNDC before installing. Needs the Docker socket, same trade-off as Watchtower. After install, docker exec tetherd tetherd doctor. Set restart policy to Unless Stopped.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: vpn gluetun wireguard rebuild-dndc docker network sidecar
Container.Requires: A container whose network others borrow (typically a VPN sidecar such as gluetun). Host access to the Docker socket. Stop Rebuild-DNDC first if it is still running.

Config.Name: Provider
Config.Description: Exact name of the VPN/network-provider container (e.g. GluetunVPN). Case-sensitive; match docker ps.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Host Docker socket. Required, same as Watchtower.

Config.Name: Unraid notifier
Config.Description: Unraid webGui, so repairs appear in the notification bell.

Config.Name: Docker templates
Config.Description: User templates, read-only, for tetherd doctor. Tetherd never rebuilds from these files.

Config.Name: Include
Config.Description: If set, only these dependents are managed. Exact names, space or comma separated.

Config.Name: Exclude
Config.Description: Dependents to leave alone. Exact names, space or comma separated.

Config.Name: Probe provider
Config.Description: Actively test that the VPN container can route. Leave false if the image already has a healthcheck (gluetun does).

Config.Name: Notify URLs
Config.Description: Apprise URLs (Discord, Telegram, Gotify, ntfy, …). Unraid's own notifier is already used when the emhttp path is mounted.
